create_MilvusClient_collection: create a MilvusClient collection with a custom name and vector dimension for embedding storage
search_MilvusClient_collection: search a MilvusClient collection using vector similarity with a configurable limit and optional filter
insert_MilvusClient_items: insert a list of VectorItem objects into a MilvusClient collection with text and metadata fields
delete_MilvusClient_items: delete items from a MilvusClient collection by specifying IDs or a metadata filter
reset_MilvusClient_database: reset the MilvusClient database by deleting all collections matching the open_webui prefix
